tips.label: be 動詞過去式
tips.text: 主詞＋was/were（＋過去時間）。I/he/she/it → was；you/we/they → were

tips.label: 一般動詞過去式
tips.text: 主詞＋動詞過去式（字尾加 ed），不論主詞是誰都不加 s/es

tips.label: 過去式疑問句
tips.text: Did＋主詞＋原形動詞...?　簡答：Yes, ... did. / No, ... didn't.

tips.label: 疑問詞開頭
tips.text: 疑問詞＋did＋主詞＋原形...?；who/what 當主詞的一般問句，直接接過去式動詞。

tips.label: 過去時間副詞
tips.text: yesterday、last＋時間、…ago、just now、the day before yesterday，前面不加 in/on/at

notes.title: be 動詞的過去式與使用時機
notes.description: 表達過去的事實或狀態。單數主詞（I/he/she/it）用 was；複數主詞與 you 用 were。句中常搭配過去時間副詞。
examples: Brian was a student last year, but he is a farmer now.
The girls were at the party last night.

notes.title: 過去時間副詞
notes.rule: yesterday（＋時間）／last＋時間／then／before／一段時間＋ago／this morning／the day before yesterday／just now／in the past／in＋過去年代
notes.description: 句中出現這些時間副詞，動詞常用過去式。注意 yesterday、last＋時間前面不加介系詞 in/on/at。
examples: It was very cold last winter.
Linda was in New York one week ago.

notes.title: be 動詞過去式的句型
notes.rule: 肯定「主詞＋was/were...」；否定「主詞＋wasn't/weren't...」；疑問「Was/Were＋主詞...?」
notes.description: 簡答時主詞一律用代名詞：Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.。否定疑問句（Wasn't/Weren't＋主詞...?）回答時不管問句是否否定，照事實回答。
examples: Were you happy last night? — Yes, I was.
They weren't actresses before.

notes.title: 疑問詞開頭、含 was/were 的疑問句
notes.rule: 疑問詞＋was/were＋主詞...（＋過去時間副詞）?
notes.description: 回答不必用 Yes/No。who 或 what 當主詞、詢問未知身分時，通常先用單數 was；回答時依實際主詞決定 was 或 were。
examples: Where were Tony and Maria last Sunday afternoon? — They were in the movie theater.
Who was outside the restaurant half an hour ago? — Amber was.

notes.title: 一般動詞過去式的規則變化
notes.rule: ①一般加 ed ②字尾有 e 只加 d ③符合短母音＋單一子音結尾的重讀音節，重複字尾子音再加 ed（w、x、y 不重複）④子音＋y：去 y 加 ied ⑤picnic → picnicked
notes.description: 過去式動詞不隨主詞變化，一律不加 s/es。例：watched、placed、shared、jogged、planned、shopped、studied、carried、cried。
examples: Tony shopped in the night market yesterday evening.
Amy studied English two days ago.

notes.title: 規則動詞字尾 ed 的發音
notes.rule: ①字尾發無聲子音 → ed 唸 [t] ②字尾發母音或有聲子音 → ed 唸 [d] ③字尾發 [t] 或 [d] → ed 唸 [ɪd]
notes.description: 記憶口訣：無聲配無聲 [t]，有聲配有聲 [d]，[t]/[d] 結尾多一個音節唸 [ɪd]。例：checked/danced/helped 唸 [t]；called/enjoyed/showed 唸 [d]；celebrated/invited/planted 唸 [ɪd]。
examples: watched [t]
jogged [d]
reminded [ɪd]

notes.title: 一般動詞過去式的句型
notes.rule: 肯定「主詞＋過去式動詞...」；否定「主詞＋didn't＋原形動詞...」；疑問「Did＋主詞＋原形動詞...?」
notes.description: didn't/Did 出現後，後面的動詞一律回到原形，字尾絕不可加 s、es、ing 或 ed。簡答：Yes, 主詞＋did. / No, 主詞＋didn't.
examples: The boy didn't wash dishes the day before yesterday.
Did you visit your grandmother last weekend? — Yes, I did.

notes.title: 否定疑問句（一般動詞）
notes.rule: Didn't＋主詞＋原形動詞...? ＝ Did＋主詞＋not＋原形動詞...?
notes.description: 回答照事實，跟肯定疑問句一樣；中譯時 Yes 譯成「不」、No 譯成「是；沒錯」。
examples: Didn't you jog yesterday evening? — Yes, I did.（不，我有。）

notes.title: 疑問詞開頭的過去式疑問句（一般動詞）
notes.description: 不必回答 Yes/No。「What did＋主詞＋do?」問做了什麼。what/who 當主詞的一般問句直接接過去式：What happened?；強調或否定等句型另有助動詞用法。
examples: When did Peter call Lisa? — He called her last Wednesday.
Who saved the little girl? — Tom did.

notes.title: be 動詞與助動詞的代替用法
notes.rule: 用 be 動詞代替前面提過的敘述；用 did 代替前面提過的「動詞＋後面的字」
notes.description: 避免重複，常見於簡答句。
examples: Bill is watching the touching movie, and we are, too.
You danced very well. — We did.

quiz.question: At this time yesterday, my parents ___ at the flower shop.
quiz.hint: at this time yesterday 指昨天這個時間；my parents 是複數，be 動詞用 were。

quiz.question: I ___ tired after the long walk last Sunday.
quiz.hint: last Sunday 表過去；主詞 I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was。

quiz.question: The music at yesterday's party ___ very lively.
quiz.hint: yesterday's party 表過去；music 是不可數名詞，搭配 was。

quiz.question: Those candles ___ on the table an hour ago.
quiz.hint: an hour ago 表過去；those candles 是複數，搭配 were。

quiz.question: A: Were you at the movie theater last night? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: 問句的 you 在回答時換成 I；過去式 be 動詞簡答用 I was。

quiz.question: A: Was your brother sad yesterday? B: No, he ___. He was happy.
quiz.hint: 問句用 Was，回答主詞 he 用 wasn't；後句說他很開心，因此是否定回答。

quiz.question: A: ___ your relatives at your house last night? B: Yes, they were.
quiz.hint: at your house 表狀態，且簡答是 they were；複數主詞的過去式問句用 Were。

quiz.question: A: Where ___ the candy yesterday? B: It was in my bag.
quiz.hint: candy 在此為不可數名詞；yesterday 表過去，問句用 Where was。

quiz.question: A: How ___ your parents after the party last night? B: They were tired.
quiz.hint: 問過去的狀態，主詞 your parents 是複數，使用 How were。

quiz.question: The flowers ___ fresh yesterday, but they are dry now.
quiz.hint: 前半句有 yesterday，flowers 是複數，應用 were；後半句才是現在的狀態。

quiz.question: My sister ___ some flowers near the tomb yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；plant 是規則動詞，過去式加 ed，成為 planted。

quiz.question: We ___ a big meal for our relatives last Saturday.
quiz.hint: last Saturday 表過去，cook 要變為過去式 cooked。

quiz.question: Leo ___ his candy with the other children yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；share 字尾已有 e，只加 d，成為 shared。

quiz.question: The students ___ to music at the party last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表過去；dance 字尾已有 e，過去式為 danced。

quiz.question: My cousin ___ English for two hours yesterday evening.
quiz.hint: yesterday evening 表過去；study 是子音加 y 結尾，去 y 加 ied，變成 studied。

quiz.question: Dad ___ the heavy chairs into the house yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；carry 是子音加 y 結尾，過去式要去 y 加 ied，成為 carried。

quiz.question: The little boy ___ when his balloon broke yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；cry 的過去式是去 y 加 ied，成為 cried。

quiz.question: After breakfast yesterday, Grandpa ___ around the park.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；jog 是短母音加單一子音結尾，重複 g 再加 ed，成為 jogged。

quiz.question: We ___ a party for Grandma last week.
quiz.hint: last week 表過去；plan 的過去式要重複 n 再加 ed，成為 planned。

quiz.question: Mom ___ for candles at the market yesterday afternoon.
quiz.hint: yesterday afternoon 表過去；shop 的過去式要重複 p 再加 ed，成為 shopped。

quiz.question: My relatives ___ in the park last Sunday.
quiz.hint: last Sunday 表過去；picnic 變過去式時要加 k 再加 ed，成為 picnicked。

quiz.question: The children ___ the touching story last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表過去；enjoy 的 y 前是母音，直接加 ed，成為 enjoyed。

quiz.question: Grandma ___ a candle beside the flowers yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表過去；place 字尾已有 e，只加 d，成為 placed。

quiz.question: My friends ___ up as ghosts for the party last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表過去；dress 的過去式是 dressed，不是第三人稱單數 dresses。

quiz.question: Uncle Ben ___ us a few days ago.
quiz.hint: a few days ago 表過去；visit 是規則動詞，過去式為 visited。

quiz.question: I didn't ___ the movie about ghosts last night.
quiz.hint: didn't 已標示過去式，後面的動詞必須用原形 watch。

quiz.question: Amy didn't ___ her cousin to the party yesterday.
quiz.hint: didn't 後接原形動詞，不能再用過去式 invited。

quiz.question: We didn't ___ in a circle at the party last night.
quiz.hint: 過去式否定句使用 didn't 加原形動詞，因此選 dance。

quiz.question: Dad didn't ___ after dinner yesterday because he was tired.
quiz.hint: didn't 後面的動詞要回到原形 jog，不能用 jogged。

quiz.question: The children didn't ___ the old story yesterday.
quiz.hint: didn't 已表達過去與否定，後面接原形 remember。

quiz.question: Did your sister ___ the flowers yesterday morning?
quiz.hint: Did 開頭的過去式問句，後面動詞使用原形 water。

quiz.question: Did you ___ the candles on the table last night?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 Did 後，主要動詞用原形 place。

quiz.question: Did the students ___ the classroom after the party yesterday?
quiz.hint: 過去式問句有 Did 時，clean 不需要再加 ed。

quiz.question: Did Grandpa ___ after the baby yesterday afternoon?
quiz.hint: Did 後接原形動詞；look after 在這裡要用 look 的原形。

quiz.question: Did Tina ___ a touching movie with you last weekend?
quiz.hint: last weekend 表過去，但問句已有 Did，主要動詞用原形 watch。

quiz.question: A: Did your relatives visit you yesterday? B: Yes, they ___.
quiz.hint: 一般動詞的過去式問句以 Did 開頭，肯定簡答用 they did。

quiz.question: A: Did your brother cook last night? B: No, he ___. Mom cooked.
quiz.hint: Did 開頭的一般動詞問句，否定簡答用 didn't；Mom cooked 說明不是哥哥煮的。

quiz.question: A: Didn't you share your candy yesterday? B: Yes, I ___. I gave some to May.
quiz.hint: 後句說確實分了一些糖果，故按事實回答 Yes, I did，即使問句是否定形式也一樣。

quiz.question: A: Didn't Leo study last night? B: No, he ___. He watched TV all evening.
quiz.hint: Leo 整晚看電視，並沒有讀書；否定問句也按事實回答 No, he didn't。

quiz.question: A: Wasn't the story touching? B: Yes, it ___. We cried at the end.
quiz.hint: 結尾大家哭了，表示故事確實感人；be 動詞否定問句的肯定回答是 Yes, it was。

quiz.question: What did your parents ___ for dinner yesterday?
quiz.hint: What did 引導過去式問句，後面的主要動詞用原形 cook。

quiz.question: Where did the children ___ flowers last Sunday?
quiz.hint: 疑問詞後已有 did，動詞用原形 plant。

quiz.question: When did your cousin ___ you about the party?
quiz.hint: When did 加主詞後，主要動詞要用原形 call。

quiz.question: A: How did you ___ for the test last week? B: I read my notes.
quiz.hint: 問句已有 did，study 要保持原形，不能改成 studied。

quiz.question: Who ___ the flowers yesterday? I want to thank that person.
quiz.hint: Who 在此是主詞，句中沒有 did；yesterday 表過去，因此直接接過去式 watered。

quiz.question: A: What ___ to the flowers during the storm last night? B: They all fell over.
quiz.hint: What 在此是主詞，last night 表過去，直接接過去式 happened；happen to 表示事情發生在某人或某物身上。

quiz.question: A: Who cleaned the table after lunch yesterday? B: My brother ___.
quiz.hint: 用 did 代替前面已提到的 cleaned the table，避免重複一般動詞的過去式敘述。

quiz.question: A: Who was at the tomb yesterday morning? B: My grandparents ___.
quiz.hint: 前句是 be 動詞過去式；回答主詞 my grandparents 是複數，用 were 代替重複部分。

quiz.question: I visited Grandma yesterday, and my sister ___, too.
quiz.hint: 前半句的 visited 是一般動詞過去式，後半句用 did 代替 visited Grandma。

quiz.question: We were busy planting flowers yesterday, and Dad ___, too.
quiz.hint: 前半句用 be 動詞過去式，後半句主詞 Dad 是單數，因此用 was 代替 was busy planting flowers。
